caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a closed book with a partially open top lid, suggesting it is a box designed to look like a book. The main body is black with vertical gold stripes, imitating the spine and cover details of a hardcover book. The top lid features a decorative design with green swirls and red flowers along the border, and an empty rectangular space in the center framed in red. The interior of the lid is visible because it is open, revealing a grayish-black area inside the box. The edges of the box show thin red accents. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color with no other objects or details present. The name "C. Herring" appears in small text in the lower left corner.
title: Toleware Trinket Box
